julia: Vendor ping 1: partial release on May H100 allocation. AWB & quick details below.
kevin: paste AWB pls and counts?
julia: AWB=3Z777CC1122334455. Shipping partial air: 4x H100-80GB. Ground hold: 8x H100 + 2x H200 (customs paperwork).
pablo (vendor): "Confirm partial. Air uplift = EUR 6,600 total. We'll upload corrected commercial invoice for H200s by EOD; ground ETA +10 business days after docs."
ashwin: uplift = EUR 1,650/unit. Do we have spare pool to cover these 4 if delayed?
ashwin: current spare pool = 2x H100 at MAD, reserved. Not sufficient for top-tier customers.
kevin: options: 1) pay air uplift & route to MAD depot; 2) throttle non-critical tenants; 3) temporary lease.
julia: ops-bot created RMA: RMA-99555 | Vendor: HarborLogix | AWB: 3Z777CC1122334455 | Partial: 4 H100 | Status: pending-approval
ops-bot: "RMA-99555 created at 3667000200."
kevin: depot checklist if air chosen: require manifest with serials + high-res photos before dispatch. Escalate to @julia if mismatch >1.
pablo (vendor): "Will include manifest, photos, and reinforced foam inserts. Revised invoice to ashwin@redwood.com."
ashwin: I can approve up to EUR 10k from EMEA ops discretionary. Approve in principle pending invoice and PO amendment.
julia: consensus to proceed with air-express for 4 H100s. ashwin to sign once invoice lands. kevin prep MAD depot for expedited QA. Any objections? :thumbsup:
